AI Overview
Flickle is a free daily online movie and television guessing game inspired by Wordle. 
Reddit
·r/blankies
 +2
How It Works
Frame Mode: Players guess a daily movie or TV show using up to six sequential screenshots or frames.
Cast & Timeline Modes: Additional puzzle types let players identify films or TV shows through credited cast members, or guess actors based on chronological filmographies.
Play Options: You can access the daily challenges directly on Flickle or via alternative variants like Flickle App and Flickle Daily Movie Guess.
